tabStatusSummary.renameNote: 25 of the 70 inLiveBuilder specs have a live tree name DIFFERENT from their CAD tab name - CAD tab names and live tab names are different generations of the same tree slots (Starcaller CAD 'Tides' is live 'Moon Priest'). The mapping and its per-pair evidence live in data/classes/_live_summary.json's tabMapping.
tabStatusSummary.sec11Correction: DATAMINE-REQUEST.md Sec 11 cited '7 of 70 specs have no CAD tab' (presumably unreleased); task W4-9 found 5 of the 7 had shipped in the live builder. Task W4-14 resolves all 7 by MECHANISM rather than a pinned token table: a spec's own `name` is the live-generation label, so VALKYR->Valkyrie, WITCHKNIGHT->Black Knight, HYDROMANCY->Warden and BULWARK->Dreadnought all resolve by name against the live tab list (the last two being W4-9's 'unmatchedExtraTabs', now attributed). 0 specs remain unreleased by this re-derivation.

statusMeanings.cadOnly: the tree exists only in the CAD catalog - no live tab maps to it
statusMeanings.inLiveBuilder: this spec's tree is in the live builder payload (liveTab names it; renamed=true means the CAD tab is called something else)
statusMeanings.noCadClass: class has no data/classes/ directory at all (structural)
statusMeanings.noLiveGeometry: class has a CAD tab layer but no builder capture - liveness NOT claimed

tabStatusSummary.supersedes: task W4-11e's states (live/shippedExternal/unreleased/noTabLayer). 'live' there meant only 'a CAD tab with this token exists' - a claim about the catalog, not the game - and covered 93/101 specs including Starcaller/TIDES, whose tree does not exist in game.
